description: The update \((x,y)\mapsto(y,x+y)\) starting at \((0,1)\) gives \((F_n,F_{n+1})\) at step \(n\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.fibonacci_states (n : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.states 0 1 (fun x x_1 y => y) (fun x x_1 y => x_1 + y) n =
    (Nat.fib n, Nat.fib (n + 1))
